sections.content:
JOURNEY 02: OUR SERVICES
Professional at-home appointments & events
Designed around comfort, hygiene, and exceptional artistry. We travel directly to your home across Delhi NCR with professional equipment, sterilization standards, and hundreds of gel colors.
Delhi NCR At-Home Service
Book Appointment
Relax in the privacy and comfort of your home while we bring salon-grade equipment, electric drills, LED lamps, and top-tier soft gel collections directly to your doorstep across Delhi, Gurgaon, and Noida.
Bespoke Gel Extensions
Custom Length & Shape
Sculpted tips using professional soft gel or polygel. Lightweight, durable, and finished with your choice of high-gloss color or hand-painted nail art.
Overlay Artistry & Strengthening
Natural Nail Protection
Structured gel layer applied directly over your natural nails to add strength, prevent breaking, and provide a flawless canvas for weeks of chip-free wear.
Signature Manicure & Power Polish
Immaculate Cuticle Care
Precision Russian cuticle cleanup, nail shaping, and long-lasting gel polish application that stays ultra-shiny for up to 3+ weeks without dulling.
3D, Chrome & Custom Artistry
Tailored to Your Outfit
Custom hand-painted floral motifs, glazed chrome aura effects, French ombré fades, or 3D textured accents designed specifically to match your lehenga or style.
Travels across Delhi NCR: South Delhi, Central Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida & Aerocity. Operating hours: 12 PM – 6 PM.
Professional On-Location Services
Events & Collaborations
Divya is available for tailored on-location nail services, brand activations, and bridal parties across Delhi NCR. Elevate your gathering with bespoke nail artistry stations and personal styling.
Brand Activations
Custom branded nail art bars and express manicures for product launches, luxury retail store openings, and PR influencer experiences.
Store Events & Pop-ups
Interactive nail bars inside fashion boutiques, jewelry stores, and lifestyle destinations to delight VIP clients and drive engagement.
Corporate Events
Executive pampering lounges, wellness days, and corporate gifting stations offering quick, immaculate gel care and shaping.
Private Celebrations
Tailored on-location nail bars for bridal sangeet parties, bachelorette retreats, birthdays, and intimate home gatherings.
Launches & Shoots
Professional on-set nail styling for fashion editorials, commercial video shoots, celebrity appearances, and campaign lookbooks.
Custom Collaborations
Co-designed press-on collections, limited-edition gift boxes, and bespoke artistic partnerships with luxury fashion brands.
Bespoke Setup: We bring complete lighting, sterilization stations, and customized color menus tailored to your event theme.

sections.title: 1. How do I place an order?
sections.content:
Question: 1. How do I place an order?
Answer: Simply choose your favourite press-on design and click Order on WhatsApp. We'll guide you through the entire process, confirm your order, discuss any customizations if needed, and begin crafting your set once everything is finalized.

sections.title: 2. How long will it take to receive my order?
sections.content:
Question: 2. How long will it take to receive my order?
Answer: Every press-on set is handmade after your order is confirmed. Delivery time depends on your location and the complexity of the design. We'll share the estimated delivery timeline before we begin crafting your order.

sections.title: 3. Can I request a custom nail design?
sections.content:
Question: 3. Can I request a custom nail design?
Answer: Absolutely! If you have a reference image or your own design idea, we'd love to create a custom set that matches your vision.

sections.title: 4. Can I customise an existing press-on design?
sections.content:
Question: 4. Can I customise an existing press-on design?
Answer: Yes! If you love one of our existing designs but would like a different colour, finish, length, shape, or a few personal touches, we can customise it just for you. Every set is handcrafted after your order is confirmed, making it easy to create something that's uniquely yours.

sections.title: 5. Are your press-on nails handmade?
sections.content:
Question: 5. Are your press-on nails handmade?
Answer: Yes. Every Nails by Divya press-on set is handcrafted only after your order is confirmed. We never sell factory-made or mass-produced nail sets.

sections.title: 6. Can I reuse my press-on nails?
sections.content:
Question: 6. Can I reuse my press-on nails?
Answer: Yes! With proper application, gentle removal and good care, your press-on nails can be reused multiple times.

sections.title: 7. Do you provide at-home nail appointments?
sections.content:
Question: 7. Do you provide at-home nail appointments?
Answer: Yes. We offer professional at-home nail appointments across selected areas of Delhi NCR. Simply book an appointment through the website or contact us on WhatsApp.

sections.title: 8. Do you also take event bookings?
sections.content:
Question: 8. Do you also take event bookings?
Answer: Yes! We're available for bridal events, private parties, corporate events, brand activations, influencer collaborations, photoshoots and other special occasions. Contact us with your event details and we'll discuss the best arrangement.

sections.title: 9. What if my order arrives damaged during delivery?
sections.content:
Question: 9. What if my order arrives damaged during delivery?
Answer: If your order arrives damaged during transit, contact us within 24 hours of receiving it and share clear photos of the damage. We'll review the issue and work with you to find the best possible solution.

sections.title: 10. Can I cancel or change my order?
sections.content:
Question: 10. Can I cancel or change my order?
Answer: Since every press-on set is handcrafted after confirmation, changes or cancellations are only possible before production begins. Please contact us as soon as possible if you need assistance.

sections.title: 11. Do you deliver across India?
sections.content:
Question: 11. Do you deliver across India?
Answer: Yes! We deliver our handmade press-on nail sets across India. Delivery timelines may vary depending on your location.

sections.title: 12. What comes with my press-on nail order?
sections.content:
Question: 12. What comes with my press-on nail order?
Answer: Every order includes your handmade press-on nail set along with the essential application accessories and easy-to-follow instructions, so you can apply your nails confidently at home.

sections.title: 13. What if I'm unsure about my nail size?
sections.content:
Question: 13. What if I'm unsure about my nail size?
Answer: Don't worry! We'll guide you through a simple sizing process before confirming your order, helping you choose the best fit with confidence.

sections.title: 14. How should I care for my press-on nails?
sections.content:
Question: 14. How should I care for my press-on nails?
Answer: Avoid excessive exposure to water immediately after application, remove them gently and store them safely after use. With proper care, your handmade press-on nails can be reused multiple times.

sections.title: 15. What are the benefits of referring Nails by Divya to your friends and family?
sections.content:
Question: 15. What are the benefits of referring Nails by Divya to your friends and family?
Answer: We truly appreciate every recommendation. From time to time, we offer exclusive referral rewards, special discounts and surprise offers for customers who refer their friends and family. Follow us on Instagram or chat with us to stay updated on the latest referral benefits.

sections.title: 16. What if I'm unavailable when my order is delivered?
sections.content:
Question: 16. What if I'm unavailable when my order is delivered?
Answer: If you're unavailable during delivery, the courier may attempt another delivery or contact you to arrange a convenient time. If you already know you'll be unavailable, let us know in advance and we'll do our best to help coordinate your delivery.
